responsibility: Implements the low-level assembler serialization helpers used by DWARF, CTF, BTF, and unwind emitters to write target-correct debug data. This file owns routines for fixed-width integers, raw byte sequences, symbol deltas and section-relative offsets, LEB128 and string output, encoded address emission for DWARF EH/data formats, and the translation-unit pool of indirect constants created to materialize relocatable encoded addresses in memory when required by assembler or relocation constraints.
same_name_distinction: Implements the low-level assembler-emission routines declared in dwarf2asm.h, including actual byte/integer/LEB128/address output and the indirect-constant pool machinery used for encoded addresses. Unlike the header, this file performs serialization and target-facing emission work.
